articles.title: Karan Johar to Make Film on R&AW Founder R.N. Kao, Sets August 2028 Release
articles.excerpt: The Dharma Productions feature, based on Nitin Gokhale's 'Gentleman Spymaster,' will trace Kao's journey from 1955 to the 1971 war, timed to R&AW's 60th anniversary.
articles.image_caption: Karan Johar will make a film on R&AW founder R.N. Kao, set for release in August 2028.
articles.nri_angle: R.N. Kao is a towering but little-known figure for many NRIs; the film could become the definitive mainstream introduction to the founder of India's external intelligence agency.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: 'Angh' Wins TIFF Platform Award, Earns Path to 2027 Oscars Race
articles.excerpt: Theja Rio's debut feature — the only Indian film in TIFF's auteur-driven Platform competition — becomes eligible for the Oscars' International Feature race under new Academy rules.
articles.image_caption: Konyak Naga community members in Nagaland. Theja Rio's film Angh is set among the Konyak people and is spoken almost entirely in the Konyak language.
articles.nri_angle: For the Indian diaspora — especially North-East Indians and the large South Asian audience at TIFF — 'Angh' puts Nagaland's culture and a first-time Indian director on one of world cinema's biggest stages.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Gondhal: Marathi Folk Thriller Selected as India's Oscar Entry for 2027
articles.excerpt: The Film Federation of India has chosen Santosh Davakhar's Marathi thriller Gondhal — selected from 33 submissions — as India's official entry for the 99th Academy Awards' Best International Feature Film category.
articles.image_caption: A folk performer in a bull mask in a scene from Gondhal. The Marathi thriller has been selected as India's official entry for the 2027 Academy Awards.
articles.nri_angle: Most Marathi Oscar entries have been nearly impossible to find with subtitles outside India — but Gondhal's seven-language dubbed versions give diaspora viewers in the US, UK and Gulf a genuine chance to watch India's official pick before the ceremony.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Ajay Devgn's Two ₹50-Crore Shots: Drishyam 3 and Golmaal 5 Eye Historic Openings
articles.excerpt: Ajay Devgn has two 2026 releases left — Drishyam 3 on October 2 and Golmaal 5 — and both carry expectations of a historic ₹50-crore opening day, a feat only Shah Rukh Khan and Hrithik Roshan have managed twice.
articles.image_caption: Ajay Devgn. His upcoming releases Drishyam 3 and Golmaal 5 are tracking toward historic 50-crore opening days in India. (Photo: Wikimedia Commons / CC BY-SA 4.0)
articles.nri_angle: Opening-day records are no longer decided in India alone — diaspora audiences in the US, UK and Gulf contribute a meaningful share of Bollywood's biggest starts, and Devgn's core overseas family audience will be central to any ₹50-crore bid.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Kunal Kemmu's 'Vibe' Jumps on Day 2, Beats 'Madgaon Express' Two-Day Total
articles.excerpt: The spy comedy earned an estimated ₹2.5–2.8 crore net on Saturday, pushing its two-day total past Kunal Kemmu's directorial debut and setting up a projected ₹7.5–8 crore opening weekend.
articles.image_caption: Kunal Kemmu. His film 'Vibe' jumped on day two, beating 'Madgaon Express' two-day total.
articles.nri_angle: Preity Zinta's return and a pop-culture-driven spy comedy travel well with NRI audiences; like Madgaon Express, the film's real diaspora moment may come on streaming via its Amazon MGM Studios pipeline.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Mammootty's Cameo Fails to Lift 'Law & Order' Past ₹47 Lakh in Two Days
articles.excerpt: The Malayalam cop drama opened to ₹29 lakh and dropped to ₹18 lakh on day two, leaving its domestic total under ₹50 lakh despite a high-profile promotional pivot around Mammootty's special appearance.
articles.image_caption: Mammootty. His cameo in 'Law & Order' failed to lift the film past ₹47 lakh in two days.
articles.nri_angle: Malayalam diaspora audiences in the Gulf and North America skipped the film as negative word of mouth travelled fast; its only meaningful second act will be a quick streaming release for those viewers.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Rahul Bhatt Revisits Strained Bond With Father Mahesh Bhatt
articles.excerpt: In a new Indian Express feature, Rahul Bhatt reflects on growing up with an absent father — echoing his father Mahesh Bhatt's own account of a childhood without a father figure.
articles.image_caption: Rahul Bhatt in a photograph from around the time of his 2012 interviews. The celebrity fitness trainer has spoken repeatedly about his strained relationship with his father, filmmaker Mahesh Bhatt, a rift revisited this week by The Indian Express.
articles.nri_angle: The Bhatts' story is Bollywood-specific but the themes — absent fathers, divorce, and whether a parent owes money, presence or both — play out in Indian families everywhere, including across the diaspora.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Ayesha Kapur Returns to Bollywood 17 Years After 'Black'
articles.excerpt: The actor, who won a Filmfare Award at 11 for playing young Michelle in Sanjay Leela Bhansali's 'Black,' returns to the big screen in 'Om Ka Hari' — telling Hindustan Times the post-'Black' chatter once derailed her decision-making.
articles.image_caption: Ayesha Kapur with husband Adam Oberoi at their March 2025 wedding in Delhi, in a photo montage that includes a still of her as young Michelle in Black. Kapur has returned to Hindi cinema after a 17-year gap with the family drama Om Ka Hari.
articles.nri_angle: Born in Germany, raised in Auroville, educated in New York and now acting in Mumbai, Kapur's cross-continental life mirrors the diaspora experience — and her candid account of child stardom and adult interference resonates with parents navigating a talented child's ambitions.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Deepika Padukone and Ranveer Singh Welcome Their Second Daughter
articles.excerpt: The couple announced the birth of their second daughter, born September 19, in a joint social media post signed "Dua, Deepika & Ranveer" — crediting their first daughter, Dua, born in September 2024, with welcoming her baby sister.
articles.image_caption: Ranveer Singh and a pregnant Deepika Padukone pose together in a black-and-white maternity photoshoot. The couple announced the birth of their second daughter, born September 19, 2026, in a joint social media post signed Dua, Deepika and Ranveer.
articles.nri_angle: The couple counts among the most-followed Indian cultural figures globally, and their family milestones travel instantly through diaspora networks — resonating with parents abroad balancing careers and young families.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Mindy Kaling Calls Maitreyi Ramakrishnan 'Sparkly' as Netflix's Best of the Best Drops
articles.excerpt: Kaling posted an emotional Instagram tribute to Ramakrishnan — the actress she cast in Never Have I Ever — as the Bollywood-fusion dance film hit Netflix.
articles.image_caption: Maitreyi Ramakrishnan. Mindy Kaling called the Never Have I Ever star 'sparkly' on Instagram as Netflix released Best of the Best on September 18, 2026.
articles.nri_angle: The film's journey from campus dance circuits to a global Netflix release marks how the South Asian American dance scene has become mainstream cultural capital.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Bhumi Pednekar Walks for Nazranaa at New York Fashion Week in Maroon Lehenga
articles.excerpt: The Bollywood actor made her runway debut at NYFW as the showstopper for Nazranaa's Samskriti 2.0 collection, a line inspired by Indian temple architecture and craft traditions.
articles.image_caption: Bhumi Pednekar walks the runway in a maroon velvet lehenga. She closed the show as the showstopper for Nazranaa's Samskriti 2.0 collection at New York Fashion Week.
articles.nri_angle: A New Jersey Indian-American bridal house closing NYFW with a Bollywood star shows how diaspora fashion businesses are carrying Indian craft onto the global runway in their own right.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Netflix's 'Best of the Best' Brings College Bollywood Dance to the World
articles.excerpt: Six years after pitching a love letter to the college desi dance circuit, Hasan Minhaj's Bollywood-fusion comedy — starring Maitreyi Ramakrishnan and Priyanka Kedia and directed by Lena Khan — arrives on Netflix on September 18.
articles.image_caption: Hasan Minhaj attends the world premiere of Netflix's 'Best of the Best.' The Bollywood dance comedy brings collegiate competitive dance culture to a global audience.
articles.nri_angle: A mainstream Netflix comedy treats the South Asian collegiate dance circuit — a defining coming-of-age institution for diaspora students — as its hero setting rather than background color.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: 'Avengers: Endgame Encore' Smashes ₹5 Crore in India Advance Sales, Eyes Re-Release Record
articles.excerpt: A week before release, the Marvel reissue has sold 100,000 advance tickets and is gunning for Baahubali: The Epic's all-time re-release opening record.
articles.image_caption: Captain America wielding Mjolnir in ‘Avengers: Endgame.’ The film’s re-release is projected to set an India advance-sales record.
articles.nri_angle: Marvel's box-office clout in India — the diaspora's home-market moviegoing barometer — is back, with a re-release outpacing many fresh releases in advance sales.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Deepika and Ranveer Seek Siddhivinayak Blessings Ahead of Second Child's Birth
articles.excerpt: The couple repeated the Siddhivinayak pilgrimage they made before daughter Dua's birth, arriving in matching purple as Ganeshotsav filled Mumbai.
articles.image_caption: Deepika Padukone at a public appearance. The actor and husband Ranveer Singh visited the Siddhivinayak Temple in Mumbai ahead of the birth of their second child.
articles.nri_angle: Deepika and Ranveer's temple pilgrimage before each child's birth resonates with diaspora families who keep their own faith traditions alive across continents.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Marathi Thriller 'Gondhal' Is India's Official Entry for Oscars 2027
articles.excerpt: Santosh Davakhar's folk-ritual thriller, chosen from 33 contenders, becomes only the fourth Marathi film ever to carry India's Oscar flag.
articles.nri_angle: For the diaspora, India's Oscar entry is the annual moment Indian cinema speaks to Hollywood — and a Marathi folk-ritual thriller is the most unconventional choice in years.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sajid Nadiadwala to Make Big-Budget Lalit Modi Biopic; Ranveer Singh Eyed for Lead
articles.excerpt: Pinkvilla reports Nadiadwala Grandson Entertainment is developing the IPL founder's life story with Sneha Rajani scripting — and Modi himself says Ranveer Singh visited him in London to discuss the role.
articles.image_caption: IPL founder Lalit Modi. Producer Sajid Nadiadwala is developing a big-budget biopic on his life, with Sneha Rajani leading the scripting.
articles.nri_angle: The IPL founder's life story — from building cricket's richest league to exile in London — has global resonance for a diaspora that made the league a worldwide phenomenon.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Konkona's Birthday Post for Amol Parashar Sparks 'Hard Launch' Frenzy
articles.excerpt: A playful reel for Amol Parashar's 40th birthday sent fans — and half of Bollywood's comment section — into speculation overdrive about the long-rumoured couple.
articles.image_caption: Konkona Sen Sharma and Amol Parashar appear together in a playful video. Konkona's Instagram reel for Amol's 40th birthday on September 17 prompted fans to call it a 'hard launch' of their rumoured relationship.
articles.nri_angle: Bollywood relationship speculation travels at fibre-optic speed through diaspora fan communities — a 'hard launch' from two actors as respected as Konkona and Amol dominates group chats from Edison to Edgbaston.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Vijay Sethupathi's 'Maharaja' Heads to Hollywood in Landmark Tamil Remake Deal
articles.excerpt: The 2024 neo-noir thriller will be the first Tamil film officially remade by a major Hollywood studio, after its ₹91.65 crore run in China caught the attention of an American agency.
articles.image_caption: Film stills show Vijay Sethupathi as the barber Maharaja, including the bloodied barber-chair sequence from the film. The producers announced on September 16 that the 2024 Tamil thriller will be remade in Hollywood by a major studio, billing it as the first Tamil film to get an official Hollywood adaptation.
articles.nri_angle: A Tamil thriller that reached diaspora audiences through Netflix is being re-imported to American screens, making it the first Tamil film to get a Hollywood remake.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Christopher Nolan's Odyssey Nears Hollywood's Top 6 All-Time in India
articles.excerpt: At ₹189.9 crore after 52 days, the Nolan epic needs only a fraction more to pass Avatar: Fire And Ash's ₹190.5 crore and claim the No. 6 spot among Hollywood's biggest Indian grossers ever.
articles.image_caption: A still from Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey. After 52 days in theaters, the epic has collected ₹188.14 crore net in India and is closing in on Avatar: Fire And Ash for sixth place among Hollywood’s all-time Indian grossers.
articles.nri_angle: The Odyssey's India haul shows Indian audiences reshaping Hollywood's global records, giving diaspora moviegoers a homegrown box-office storyline to celebrate alongside the film's worldwide success.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: From Phoolan to Nagaland's First Feature, Indian Cinema Takes Over Toronto
articles.excerpt: Months after Cannes selected no Indian film in any section, the Toronto International Film Festival has programmed Indian titles across five sections — from Richie Mehta's Phoolan to a 4K restoration of John Abraham's 1986 Malayalam classic Amma Ariyan.
articles.nri_angle: Toronto is home to one of the largest Indian diaspora communities in the world, where Indian films routinely sell out at TIFF — for many NRIs, the festival's Indian lineup is a first look at the films that will dominate conversation back home and on streaming.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Meghna Gulzar on Irrfan Khan: 'Everything He Did, He Made Me Look Good'
articles.excerpt: Speaking to The Indian Express's Expresso series ahead of Daayra's September 18 release, the Raazi and Talvar director reflected on Irrfan Khan, Vicky Kaushal and Deepika Padukone — and said she still doesn't know which side of Talvar Irrfan believed.
articles.image_caption: Filmmaker Meghna Gulzar with Irrfan Khan. She directed him as investigator DCP Ashwin Kumar in Talvar.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora audiences who know Talvar and Raazi primarily through streaming, the Expresso conversation offers a rare window into how one of Hindi cinema's most restrained directors draws performances from its most demanding actors.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Mandakini on Ram Teri Ganga Maili at 41: 'I Went With the Flow'
articles.excerpt: Four decades after Raj Kapoor's 1985 classic made her a star, the actress has reflected on the film's controversial scenes, telling The Indian Express's Expresso series that as a young newcomer she simply trusted her director and followed his vision.
articles.image_caption: Actor Mandakini. She starred in Raj Kapoor's Ram Teri Ganga Maili, which turned 41 this year.
articles.nri_angle: For the diaspora generation that grew up watching the film on VHS tapes and cable reruns, the Expresso conversation is a nostalgic re-examination of a film whose most famous scenes overshadowed everything else about it.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Reconstitutes Censor Board With 18 New Members, Including Grammy Winner Ricky Kej
articles.excerpt: The Information and Broadcasting Ministry has appointed an 18-member Central Board of Film Certification for a three-year term, naming actors Suniel Shetty, Pankaj Tripathi and Preity Zinta, filmmakers Priyadarshan and Nila Madhab Panda, and Grammy-winning composer Ricky Kej to the panel that certifies films for public exhibition.
articles.image_caption: A collage shows Suniel Shetty, Preity Zinta, Priyadarshan and Pankaj Tripathi. All four were named among the 18 members of the reconstituted Central Board of Film Certification announced on September 16, 2026.
articles.nri_angle: The CBFC-certified version of a film is the version that plays in Indian cinemas and typically shapes diaspora entertainment debates abroad, so the industry-led board's certification calls will matter to Bollywood's large NRI audiences in the Gulf, the US, the UK and Canada.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Anant Nag to Receive Dadasaheb Phalke Award; Modi Hails 'Remarkable Versatility'
articles.excerpt: The Kannada cinema veteran, whose career spans five decades and more than 300 films, will receive Indian cinema's highest honour at the 72nd National Film Awards in Kevadia on September 22.
articles.image_caption: Kannada cinema veteran Anant Nag, named the recipient of the Dadasaheb Phalke Award, India's highest film honour. Prime Minister Narendra Modi hailed his remarkable versatility.
articles.nri_angle: For the Kannada and Indian diaspora worldwide — a large audience in the US and Gulf — Nag's Malgudi Days and five-decade filmography are shared cultural memory, making the honour a moment of community pride beyond India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Nafisa Ali Shares Health Update as She Begins Targeted Therapy
articles.excerpt: The veteran actress told followers on Instagram that a PET/CT scan showed new deposits on her liver, and that her medical team has moved her onto targeted therapy.
articles.image_caption: Nafisa Ali smiles at an event, wearing a red saree with a decorative blue border and gold jewelry. The veteran Bollywood actress has shared that her Stage 4 cancer has progressed and she is beginning targeted therapy.
articles.nri_angle: For many in the Indian diaspora facing cancer in their own families, Ali's plain-spoken public updates have become a touchstone — a well-known face describing scans, protocols and setbacks in language other patients recognize.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Bollywood's Biggest Stars Turn Out for Ambani Family Ganpati Celebrations
articles.excerpt: The Ambani family's Ganesh Chaturthi celebration at Antilia on September 14 drew a who's-who of Bollywood and cricket, with stars from Salman Khan to Alia Bhatt arriving for the evening's aarti.
articles.image_caption: Alia Bhatt and Ranbir Kapoor, Janhvi Kapoor, and Katrina Kaif with Vicky Kaushal pose in festive wear at the Ambani family Ganpati celebration in Mumbai. The September 14 gathering at Antilia drew Bollywood biggest stars for the annual aarti.
articles.nri_angle: The Antilia gathering is Ganesh Chaturthi's most visible expression — the version that fills diaspora social media feeds the morning after.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Amitabh Bachchan Dismisses Retirement Talk After Late-Night Blog Sparks Frenzy
articles.excerpt: The 83-year-old described hosting KBC 18 as a 'heart-breaking experience' before signing off with 'I wish to retire now' — a line that set off a frenzy he later brushed aside.
articles.image_caption: Amitabh Bachchan. The actor dismissed talk of retirement following his latest public appearance.
articles.nri_angle: KBC is a shared ritual the diaspora streams on Sony LIV alongside relatives in India, so rumours of Bachchan's exit travel fast in NRI group chats.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Mirzapur The Movie a Clean Hit on Day 10, Enters 2026's Top 5 Grossers
articles.excerpt: Ten days in, the Prime Video spin-off has collected ₹189.67 crore net in India on a ₹90 crore budget — a 110.74% return on investment that trade trackers call a clean hit, making it Bollywood's fourth such verdict of 2026.
articles.image_caption: The theatrical poster for Mirzapur The Movie, the film offshoot of the Prime Video series. The film secured a clean hit verdict on day 10 of its theatrical run with a 110.74% return on investment.
articles.nri_angle: The film's overseas markets, led by North America and the Middle East, have contributed about ₹46 crore by day 10 — roughly a fifth of its worldwide gross — as diaspora audiences turned a streaming-known property into a theatrical draw.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: How to Watch the Emmys in India: Time, Channels and Top Nominees
articles.excerpt: The 78th Primetime Emmy Awards air on September 14 in the US — and stream live in India in the early hours of September 15 on JioHotstar. Here's the full timing, the nominees to watch, and the Indian names in the mix.
articles.image_caption: The Emmy statuette in artwork for the 78th Primetime Emmy Awards. The ceremony airs in India on September 15, with the red carpet at 4:30 AM IST and the main show at 5:30 AM IST, streaming live on JioHotstar.
articles.nri_angle: Priyanka Chopra's Heads of State is nominated for Outstanding Television Movie and Huma Qureshi is the only Indian actress attending, while JioHotstar's exclusive live stream makes the ceremony accessible to Indian and diaspora viewers.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
